name: vm_strap_q2_ref-strap4hookfix-COMMIT
purpose: Strap-identity quadrant master (coordinator decision per DEDUPE, 2026-10-15): bank / slice identity is a registered strap input (bid[2:0] / sid[1:0] pins, tied to die constants per instance, captured by pin flops), so the 8 banks of the quadrant use this ONE view; replaces the 8 literal-identity masters. Same data calendars and edges as identity2. Pins: identity2 r2 grant (actual tracks, PG-clear, explicit centres) + 5 strap pins on free N-face tracks beside the clock pair (proposal for H-DIE).
